description: Non material amendment to approved application DM2025/00266 which allowed the 'Demolition of the existing buildings, erection of a warehouse, storage building, welfare building, weighbridge office, sprinkler pump and control room, sprinkler tanks, relocation of electrical substation and provision of new boundary treatments, access gates, parking spaces and cycle storage for use of the site as a waste transfer and recycling station,' to provide a front extension to facilitate sprinkler valve room, increase substation footprint, enlargement of sprinkler pump room, provision of external staircases to rear and vehicle access gate to front, relocation of welfare building, replacement of two sprinkler tanks with one tank, removal of high windows to rear, alteration and relocation of shutter doors, alteration to parking layout and solar panel layout and alterations to cladding colour.
